blocks.title: Every line, every year

blocks.alt: The fiscal year the line-by-line view below shows

so.text: The view below shows the year picked here; how much it can show depends on which record holds that year.

blocks.title: Fiscal year

blocks.alt: For the fiscal year picked: a banner naming the record it comes from; for a journal year, the lines flagged underfunded, overbudgeted and restarted high, each with its figures and threshold, then every school line with voted, transfers, carried in, final budget, spent and left; for a budget-document year, every line’s budget against its actual

basis.label: Each line’s vote, transfers and spending, from the record named in the banner

flags.ours: Thresholds of ours: $5,000 and 10%, the same for all three flags.

over.means: The line was voted more than it spent; the rest went to other lines or into the surplus.
over.name: Overbudgeted
over.rule: The vote and any orders carried in came to at least $5,000 and 10% of the vote more than the line spent, and budget was moved out or left at year end.

restart.means: The new budget started above what the line had just cost. Compared with the prior year’s spending and its final budget; both are shown.
restart.name: Restarted high
restart.rule: This year’s vote is at least $5,000 and 10% above what the same account spent the year before, counting bills later re-charged to other funds.

under.means: The vote was below what the line cost that year; transfers from other lines closed some or all of the gap.
under.name: Underfunded
under.rule: Budget was transferred in during the year, and the line spent past its vote and any orders carried in by at least $5,000 and 10% of the vote.

flags.why: A flag is a measurement. Why a line was set where it was is not shown by the books: a vacancy, a placement, a price or a plan can each produce it.

text.above: Above last year’s final budget too
text.banner_books: From the district’s budget documents only. They print no mid-year transfers and no account numbers, so the three flags are not shown. The accounting system’s figures for each line this year are in a Finance Committee workbook this page does not read yet.
text.banner_ledger: From the school journal: the Town’s accounting system, every line tied to its year-end report. Spent counts orders still owed at 30 June.
text.banner_none: From the district’s budget documents only, and not comparable: in 116 of 117 lines the documents print this year’s budget, to the dollar, in the column headed actual.
text.below: At or below last year’s final budget

books_cols.name: Line, as the documents name it

text.cut: Budget was moved off it the year before

means.budget: Voted, plus transfers, plus carried in.
means.carried: Last year’s orders still owed, carried in with the money to pay them.
means.left: Final budget less spent. Above zero it added to the surplus.
means.spent: Payments, plus orders still owed at 30 June.
means.transfers: Budget moved to or from other lines during the year.
means.voted: What Town Meeting voted for this line.

text.no_link: Lines here are the district’s printed names, not account numbers, so they do not link to a line’s page; those pages begin in FY2023.
text.not_shown: Not shown for this year: it needs each line’s transfers, which the budget documents do not print.
text.not_shown_restart: Not shown for this year: this flag matches lines by account number, and the budget documents print names, not accounts.
text.recharged: Re-charged to other funds after the school budget paid
text.thin: Spent under half its final budget the year before (a mark of ours): its history may show the cost moved to another account.

so.text: A flag marks where the vote and the year parted; the transfers listed under it show where the budget went. The books do not record why.

blocks.title: Line by line

paragraphs.text: **The budget documents** print a budget and an actual column the district wrote. Lines are read with the rules of the August analysis: a line under $10,000, a cell two documents disagree about, and FY2021 are not counted.
**The school journal** is the Town’s own accounting record, and every line here ties to its year-end report. It records transfers between lines, which the documents never do.
**They are never added together.** Where both cover a year, this page reads the journal.

note.text: Spent against the vote, private and collaborative tuition together. The documents’ years before the journal; the journal’s from FY2023.

so.text: A salary vote leaves room the year usually does not use; that room is where a surplus starts. Why, post by post, the books do not say.

conclusions.text: Salary lines came in under their vote in 4 of 4 journal years; the documents agree, at −0.80%.

so.text: Lines miss in both directions and cancel; a total near its vote says little about any line in it.

conclusions.text: Only 11 of 99 lines missed the same way in all 4 journal years; in the documents, 7 of 98.

so.text: No trend to project: the site’s projection holds this line flat rather than growing it at a rate.

conclusions.text: Out-of-district tuition missed from +27.0% to −51.5%, in both directions, FY2018–FY2026.

so.text: Each is a question for the next budget: was the cut a one-year saving, or a line set high?

conclusions.text: 51 of 163 times a line gave budget up mid-year, its next vote was 10% or more above its spending.
